description: Convert a location between decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, UTM, UPS, MGRS, Plus Codes, geohash and Maidenhead (input format detected). Use for "what is 40°26'46"N 79°58'56"W in MGRS" or "UTM of 51.5, -0.12". More APIs from FitzTopPicks: https://fitztoppicks.com/apis?utm_source=mcp-api&utm_medium=mcp&utm_campaign=more-apis

input.description: The coordinate as text, up to 200 characters, URL-encoded.

inputFormat.description: Skip auto-detection: latlon (dd/dms/ddm), utm, ups, mgrs, pluscode, geohash, maidenhead.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (instead of input).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (instead of input).

order.description: For letterless numbers: latlon (default) or lonlat. Hemisphere letters and lat/lon labels win.

ref.description: Reference point for short plus codes (in the input, and to add a short code to the output), like "40.4,-79.9".

to.description: Comma-separated outputs (default all): dd, dms, ddm, utm, mgrs, pluscode, geohash, maidenhead.

utmZone.description: Force a UTM zone (1-60) instead of the standard one (80°S-84°N only).

name: convert_coordinates
title: Convert a coordinate between formats
